hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$(printf '%s' "$input" | tr -d '"\\\047')" in *gh*merge*|*merge*gh*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; f=$(mktemp) || exit 2; trap 'rm -f "$f"' EXIT; git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" fetch -q origin main && git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" show origin/main:scripts/pr/merge-guard-hook.sh > "$f" || { echo 'merge-guard: origin/main の hook を取得できないため deny' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$input" | bash "$f"

command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.rs) d=$(dirname "$f"); e=""; while [ -z "$e" ]; do [ -f "$d/Cargo.toml" ] && e=$(grep -m 1 -o '^edition *= *"[0-9]*"' "$d/Cargo.toml" | tr -dc 0-9); [ "$d" = "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] || [ "$d" = / ] && break; d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -n "$e" ] && rustfmt --edition "$e" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
